app.name: Batch Rename
app.description: Batch rename Eagle items and audit Synology Drive naming compatibility.

ui.appDescription: Read the current Eagle selection, preview rules, and batch update item names.
ui.nasDescription: Scan Eagle items for names and paths that may fail Synology Drive sync.
ui.nasRulesNote: Sorted by Synology Drive / Windows compatibility: full paths over 247 characters, names over 255 characters, illegal characters, and names starting with ~ are prioritized.
ui.nasEmpty: Scan the selection or library first.
ui.nasNoRisk: No Synology Drive naming risks found.
ui.nasHiddenRowsNotice: {count} more risky items are hidden. They remain in the scan result and can be imported in later batches.
ui.nasNoEagleApi: Eagle API was not detected, so the library cannot be scanned.
ui.nasScanDone: Audit complete: scanned {total} items; found {risks} risky items.
ui.nasScanCanceled: Audit stopped: scanned {scanned}/{total}; found {risks} risky items.
ui.nasImportNoResults: No risky items are available to import.
ui.nasImportDone: Imported {count} risky items into the batch rename list.
ui.nasSwitchDenied: A rename task is running; modules cannot be switched yet.
ui.hintOriginal: Use * to insert the original name.
ui.hintNumber: Use # to insert a number or letter sequence.
ui.replaceToPlaceholder: Replacement text; leave empty to delete
ui.removeTextPlaceholder: Specific text; leave empty to skip
ui.performanceDefault: Use batches for large file sets.
ui.selectionSummary: {total} items. Check rows to remove or reorder.
ui.selectionSummaryLimited: {total} items. Rendering only the first {visible} rows for performance.
ui.noRowsRefresh: Select items in Eagle, then click “Refresh Selection”.
ui.hiddenRowsNotice: {count} more items are not rendered in the table, but they will still be validated and renamed.
ui.runningRefreshDenied: A task is running; the selection cannot be refreshed.
ui.noEagleApi: Eagle API was not detected. Run this inside an Eagle plugin window.
ui.listCleared: The processing list has been cleared.
ui.chooseMove: Check the rows you want to move first.
ui.duplicateError: Error: duplicate name in this list
ui.trailingName: Error: cannot end with a space or dot
ui.fixErrors: {count} errors must be fixed before running.
ui.terminating: Stopping task and closing the window...
ui.closeMessage: The rename task is still running. Stop it and close the window?
ui.closeDetail: Already saved items will not be rolled back. Unprocessed items keep their original names. The current list and progress will not be kept after closing.
